name: canonical-0844-off-shift
description: Canonical day (Europe/London in January = UTC): shift 09:00–15:00, a 15-minute RELAX_ALL break started 10:15 and never closed by the device. 08:44:59 is one second before the 15-minute pre-shift window.

name: canonical-0845-starting-soon
description: Canonical day (Europe/London in January = UTC): shift 09:00–15:00, a 15-minute RELAX_ALL break started 10:15 and never closed by the device. 08:45 opens the pre-shift window (inclusive).

name: canonical-0859-starting-soon
description: Canonical day (Europe/London in January = UTC): shift 09:00–15:00, a 15-minute RELAX_ALL break started 10:15 and never closed by the device. 08:59 is still SHIFT_STARTING_SOON; restrictions are not active yet.

name: canonical-0859-59-999-starting-soon-last-ms
description: Canonical day (Europe/London in January = UTC): shift 09:00–15:00, a 15-minute RELAX_ALL break started 10:15 and never closed by the device. 08:59:59.999 is the last instant before the shift start: still SHIFT_STARTING_SOON ([start, end) is half-open).

name: canonical-0900-working
description: Canonical day (Europe/London in January = UTC): shift 09:00–15:00, a 15-minute RELAX_ALL break started 10:15 and never closed by the device. 09:00 is the shift start (inclusive): WORKING, next change is the break start.

name: canonical-1015-on-break
description: Canonical day (Europe/London in January = UTC): shift 09:00–15:00, a 15-minute RELAX_ALL break started 10:15 and never closed by the device. 10:15 the break starts: ON_BREAK with every category lifted.

name: canonical-1029-59-999-on-break-last-ms
description: Canonical day (Europe/London in January = UTC): shift 09:00–15:00, a 15-minute RELAX_ALL break started 10:15 and never closed by the device. 10:29:59.999 is the last instant of the break (plannedEndsAt > now): still ON_BREAK.

name: canonical-1030-break-expired
description: Canonical day (Europe/London in January = UTC): shift 09:00–15:00, a 15-minute RELAX_ALL break started 10:15 and never closed by the device. 10:30 the break's plannedEndsAt is reached; the row is still ACTIVE but is treated as EXPIRED → WORKING.

name: canonical-1455-shift-ending
description: Canonical day (Europe/London in January = UTC): shift 09:00–15:00, a 15-minute RELAX_ALL break started 10:15 and never closed by the device. 14:55 opens the 5-minute SHIFT_ENDING window (inclusive); restrictions stay on.

name: canonical-1456-shift-ending
description: Canonical day (Europe/London in January = UTC): shift 09:00–15:00, a 15-minute RELAX_ALL break started 10:15 and never closed by the device. 14:56 is inside the SHIFT_ENDING window.

name: canonical-1459-59-999-shift-ending-last-ms
description: Canonical day (Europe/London in January = UTC): shift 09:00–15:00, a 15-minute RELAX_ALL break started 10:15 and never closed by the device. 14:59:59.999 is the last instant of the shift: still SHIFT_ENDING.

name: canonical-1500-off-shift
description: Canonical day (Europe/London in January = UTC): shift 09:00–15:00, a 15-minute RELAX_ALL break started 10:15 and never closed by the device. 15:00 is the shift end (exclusive): OFF_SHIFT and no future shift, so nextTransitionAt is null.

name: break-ended-early-by-employee
description: Shift 09:00–15:00; a break 10:15–10:30 was ended by the employee at 10:20 (status ENDED). At 10:22 the employee is WORKING.

name: break-ended-row-evaluated-before-its-end
description: The same ENDED row (10:15, ended 10:20) evaluated at 10:18: a session counts during [startedAt, min(plannedEndsAt, endedAt)) whatever its status, so past instants (replays) still see the break.

name: break-active-row-with-endedat
description: An ACTIVE row that already carries endedAt 10:20 (status not yet flipped to ENDED) ends at its endedAt: at 10:19 still ON_BREAK, and 10:20 is the next change.

name: break-ended-late-capped-at-planned-end
description: An ENDED row whose endedAt (10:40) was reported after its plannedEndsAt (10:30): the planned end still caps the break (plannedEndsAt ≤ now → expired), so at 10:35 the employee is WORKING.

name: break-ended-without-endedat-ignored
description: An ENDED row with no endedAt has no usable window and is ignored: WORKING.

name: break-of-unknown-shift-ignored
description: An ACTIVE break whose shiftId is not one of the supplied (effective) shifts is ignored.

name: break-of-cancelled-shift-ignored
description: A running break whose shift is CANCELLED is ignored even though a SCHEDULED shift covers the same time: WORKING.

name: break-keep-restrictions
description: A break whose policy snapshot is KEEP_RESTRICTIONS: ON_BREAK but the WORK restriction stays fully active.

name: break-relax-categories
description: RELAX_CATEGORIES break with a messy stored JSON list (duplicate, unknown entry, non-canonical order): only the known categories are lifted, in canonical order, and the rest stay enforced.

name: break-relax-categories-empty-list
description: RELAX_CATEGORIES with an empty list lifts nothing: ON_BREAK with the WORK restriction (same as breakRestrictionForSession).

name: break-relax-categories-every-category
description: RELAX_CATEGORIES listing every category: BREAK_RELAXED with nothing left enforced (restrictionsShouldBeActive false), same as RELAX_ALL for the device.

name: break-expires-inside-shift-ending-window
description: Break 14:45–14:57 expires inside the 14:55–15:00 SHIFT_ENDING window: at 14:57 the state is SHIFT_ENDING (not WORKING); next change is the shift end.

name: overnight-2150-starting-soon
description: Overnight shift 22:00 → 06:00 the next day. 21:50 is inside the pre-shift window.

name: overnight-0200-working
description: Overnight shift 22:00 → 06:00: at 02:00 after midnight the employee is WORKING; the next change is SHIFT_ENDING at 05:55.

name: overnight-0557-shift-ending
description: Overnight shift 22:00 → 06:00: 05:57 is inside the SHIFT_ENDING window.

name: dst-spring-forward-starting-soon
description: Europe/London spring-forward night: shift 22:00 GMT Sat → 06:00 BST Sun (7 real hours). 21:45 local is SHIFT_STARTING_SOON.

name: dst-spring-forward-0230-local
description: Spring-forward night: 01:30Z is 02:30 BST (local 01:00–02:00 never happened). WORKING; the next change is SHIFT_ENDING at 05:55 BST = 04:55Z, not a wall-clock-naive 05:55Z.

name: dst-spring-forward-shift-ending
description: Spring-forward night: 04:56Z is 05:56 BST, inside SHIFT_ENDING; the shift ends at 06:00 BST = 05:00Z.

name: dst-fall-back-first-0130
description: Europe/London fall-back night: shift 22:00 BST Sat → 06:00 GMT Sun (9 real hours). 00:30Z is the FIRST 01:30 local (BST): WORKING.

name: dst-fall-back-second-0130
description: Fall-back night: 01:30Z is the SECOND 01:30 local (GMT): still WORKING, same next transition.

name: dst-fall-back-shift-ending
description: Fall-back night: 05:55Z = 05:55 GMT opens SHIFT_ENDING; the shift ends at 06:00Z.

name: b2b-1256-no-shift-ending
description: Back-to-back shifts 09:00–13:00 and 13:00–17:00 merge into one working interval 09:00–17:00: restrictions never flap at 13:00. 12:56 would be SHIFT_ENDING for the first shift alone; merged it is WORKING and the next change is 16:55.

name: b2b-1259-shifts-out-of-order
description: Back-to-back shifts 09:00–13:00 and 13:00–17:00 merge into one working interval 09:00–17:00: restrictions never flap at 13:00. Shifts supplied in reverse order; 12:59 is WORKING on the first shift.

name: b2b-1300
description: Back-to-back shifts 09:00–13:00 and 13:00–17:00 merge into one working interval 09:00–17:00: restrictions never flap at 13:00. 13:00: the active shift becomes the second one, nothing else changes.

name: b2b-1301
description: Back-to-back shifts 09:00–13:00 and 13:00–17:00 merge into one working interval 09:00–17:00: restrictions never flap at 13:00. 13:01: WORKING on the second shift.

name: b2b-1655-shift-ending
description: Back-to-back shifts 09:00–13:00 and 13:00–17:00 merge into one working interval 09:00–17:00: restrictions never flap at 13:00. 16:55: SHIFT_ENDING applies only to the end of the merged interval.

name: b2b-break-ends-at-own-shift-end
description: Back-to-back shifts 09:00–13:00 and 13:00–17:00 merge into one working interval 09:00–17:00: restrictions never flap at 13:00. A break of the first shift planned 12:50–13:05 is still running at 12:59; its own shift ends at 13:00, which is the next change (only the relaxation ends there, not Work Mode).

name: b2b-break-across-boundary
description: Back-to-back shifts 09:00–13:00 and 13:00–17:00 merge into one working interval 09:00–17:00: restrictions never flap at 13:00. A break of the first shift (12:50–13:05, e.g. the shift was shortened after the break began) is terminated by its own shift's end at 13:00 — shift end always terminates a break, the same bound breaks/ applies — so at 13:02 the employee is WORKING on the second shift. Work Mode itself never stopped.

name: overlapping-shifts-union
description: Overlapping shifts 09:00–13:00 and 12:00–17:00 form one interval 09:00–17:00; at 12:30 the earliest-starting covering shift is active.

name: overlapping-shift-contained
description: A short shift 12:00–13:00 contained in 09:00–17:00 does not create a SHIFT_ENDING at 12:55: at 12:58 WORKING on the earliest-starting covering shift; next change 16:55.

name: overlap-break-ends-at-own-shift-end
description: A break of the contained shift 12:00–13:00 (inside 09:00–17:00) planned 12:50–13:10 ends at its own shift's end, 13:00 — shift end always terminates a break — while Work Mode continues in the merged interval. At 12:55 the active shift is the earliest-starting covering one.

name: gap-between-shifts-starting-soon
description: Shifts 09:00–12:00 and 12:10–15:00 are NOT adjacent. At 12:00 the first has ended and the second is imminent.

name: gap-between-shifts-shift-ending
description: Shifts 09:00–12:00 and 12:10–15:00: at 11:57 the first shift is ending; next change at 12:00.

name: precedence-working-over-next-shift-starting-soon
description: Shifts 09:00–12:00 and 12:05–15:00 (5-minute gap). At 11:52 the next shift's pre-shift window (from 11:50) is open, but WORKING outranks SHIFT_STARTING_SOON while the first shift is in progress; next change is SHIFT_ENDING at 11:55.

name: short-shift-shift-ending-throughout
description: A 3-minute shift 09:00–09:03 is shorter than the 5-minute ending window: SHIFT_ENDING from its first instant.

name: break-crosses-shift-end-during
description: Break 14:50–15:10 on a shift ending 15:00 (e.g. the shift was shortened mid-break). At 14:57 ON_BREAK beats SHIFT_ENDING; the shift end at 15:00 terminates the break.

name: break-crosses-shift-end-after
description: Same break at 15:00: the shift end terminated it even though plannedEndsAt (15:10) is in the future.

name: exempt-temporarily-during-shift
description: EXEMPT_TEMPORARILY 10:00–12:00 during the shift: MANAGER_OVERRIDE, restrictions NONE until it expires.

name: exempt-temporarily-precedes-break
description: EXEMPT_TEMPORARILY beats a running RELAX_ALL break. The break session keeps running underneath (still reported) and its expiry at 10:30 is the next change.

name: exempt-temporarily-ends-while-break-runs
description: EXEMPT_TEMPORARILY 10:00–10:20 expires while break-1 (10:15–10:30) is still running: at 10:20 the employee is ON_BREAK with the break relaxation, not WORKING.

name: exempt-temporarily-before-shift
description: EXEMPT_TEMPORARILY 08:00–10:00 applies from the pre-shift window: at 08:50 MANAGER_OVERRIDE; entering the shift at 09:00 is the next change.

name: override-not-yet-started
description: An EXEMPT_TEMPORARILY override 12:00–13:00 has not started at 11:00: WORKING, next change at its start.

name: override-starts-exactly-now
description: An override is active on [startsAt, min(expiresAt, revokedAt)): at exactly 10:00 the EXEMPT_TEMPORARILY 10:00–12:00 applies.

name: override-expires-exactly-now
description: At exactly its expiresAt (12:00) the EXEMPT_TEMPORARILY 10:00–12:00 no longer applies: WORKING.

name: override-revoked-exactly-now
description: At exactly its revokedAt (10:30) the EXEMPT_TEMPORARILY 10:00–14:00 no longer applies; its later expiry at 14:00 changes nothing.

name: end-work-mode-early
description: END_WORK_MODE_EARLY from 13:00 until the shift end: MANAGER_OVERRIDE; the 14:55 warning is suppressed and the next change is the shift end.

name: end-work-mode-early-in-shift-ending-window
description: END_WORK_MODE_EARLY 14:56–15:00: MANAGER_OVERRIDE beats SHIFT_ENDING at 14:57; override expiry and shift end coincide at 15:00.

name: emergency-outranks-other-lifting-overrides
description: EXEMPT_TEMPORARILY 10:00–12:00, an org-wide EMERGENCY_POLICY_OVERRIDE 10:30–11:30 and END_WORK_MODE_EARLY 10:45–15:00 all active at 11:00: EMERGENCY_POLICY_OVERRIDE ranks first. When it expires at 11:30 the reported override changes, so that is the next change.

name: end-work-mode-early-outranks-exempt
description: Same rows at 11:30: END_WORK_MODE_EARLY outranks EXEMPT_TEMPORARILY. The exemption's expiry at 12:00 changes nothing and 14:55 is masked, so the next change is the shift end at 15:00.

name: emergency-policy-override-org-wide
description: Org-wide EMERGENCY_POLICY_OVERRIDE (employeeId null) 10:00–18:00 applies to every employee: MANAGER_OVERRIDE; off shift it no longer matters, so the next change is the shift end.

name: temporary-exception-relax-categories
description: TEMPORARY_EXCEPTION 11:00–11:30 with a RELAX_CATEGORIES payload: state stays WORKING, restriction BREAK_RELAXED for the listed categories only.

name: temporary-exception-default-relax-all
description: TEMPORARY_EXCEPTION with an empty payload defaults to RELAX_ALL: WORKING, BREAK_RELAXED, nothing enforced.

name: temporary-exception-during-shift-ending
description: TEMPORARY_EXCEPTION 14:50–15:30 (RELAX_ALL) inside the SHIFT_ENDING window: state SHIFT_ENDING, restriction BREAK_RELAXED.

name: temporary-exception-keep-restrictions-no-effect
description: TEMPORARY_EXCEPTION whose payload is KEEP_RESTRICTIONS relaxes nothing, so it does not change the output and is not reported.

name: temporary-exception-no-op-does-not-mask-another
description: A KEEP_RESTRICTIONS exception 10:00–12:00 relaxes nothing, so it does not mask a RELAX_CATEGORIES [GAMES] exception 11:00–11:30 that started later: WORKING with GAMES lifted until 11:30.

name: break-beats-temporary-exception
description: A KEEP_RESTRICTIONS break 10:15–10:30 runs inside a RELAX_ALL exception 10:00–11:00: ON_BREAK outranks the exception, so the break's snapshot applies (WORK) and the exception is not reported. Its relaxation resumes when the break ends at 10:30.

name: temporary-exception-resumes-after-break
description: Same rows at 10:30: the break has expired and the exception's RELAX_ALL applies again until it expires at 11:00.

name: temporary-exception-ignored-before-shift
description: A RELAX_ALL exception 08:30–10:00 has no effect while the shift is only imminent (nothing is enforced yet): SHIFT_STARTING_SOON, not reported; the shift start at 09:00 is the next change.

name: temporary-exception-applies-at-shift-start
description: Same rows at 09:00: the shift starts with the exception's relaxation (WORKING, BREAK_RELAXED) until it expires at 10:00.

name: lifting-override-beats-temporary-exception
description: TEMPORARY_EXCEPTION 10:00–12:00 and EXEMPT_TEMPORARILY 11:00–11:30 overlap: the exemption wins; at 11:30 the exception's relaxation resumes.

name: expired-override-ignored
description: EXEMPT_TEMPORARILY 08:00–10:00 has expired by 11:00: WORKING.

name: revoked-override-ignored
description: EXEMPT_TEMPORARILY 10:00–14:00 revoked at 10:30: WORKING at 11:00.

name: override-for-other-employee-ignored
description: An EXEMPT_TEMPORARILY override scoped to another employee is ignored when employeeId is supplied.

name: override-applies-when-employee-id-omitted
description: Without input.employeeId every supplied override applies, including one scoped to another employee (callers pre-filter by employee): MANAGER_OVERRIDE until 12:00.

name: override-off-shift-ignored
description: An override active while the employee is off shift does not surface: OFF_SHIFT.

name: permission-denied-during-shift
description: Screen Time permission DENIED during the shift: PERMISSION_ERROR dominates; the intended restriction (WORK) is still reported. The output does not change at 14:55 (SHIFT_ENDING is masked by PERMISSION_ERROR), so the next real change is the shift end.

name: permission-denied-at-pre-shift-window-start
description: Permission DENIED at exactly 08:45, the first instant of the pre-shift window: the shift is imminent, so PERMISSION_ERROR (with no restriction intended yet). At 09:00 the intended restriction becomes WORK.

name: permission-denied-dominates-shift-ending
description: Permission DENIED at 14:57: PERMISSION_ERROR dominates SHIFT_ENDING; the intended WORK restriction is still reported.

name: permission-denied-at-shift-end
description: Permission DENIED at exactly 15:00: the shift is over (end-exclusive) and nothing is imminent, so OFF_SHIFT.

name: permission-denied-off-shift
description: Permission DENIED while off shift (07:00, shift at 09:00): OFF_SHIFT; the problem surfaces when the pre-shift window opens at 08:45.

name: permission-not-determined-10-min-before-shift
description: Permission NOT_DETERMINED 10 minutes before the shift (imminent): PERMISSION_ERROR with no restriction intended yet.

name: permission-unknown-just-outside-window
description: Permission UNKNOWN at 08:44, one minute before the pre-shift window: still OFF_SHIFT.

name: permission-unknown-during-shift
description: Permission UNKNOWN during the shift is not APPROVED: PERMISSION_ERROR with the intended WORK restriction; SHIFT_ENDING is masked, so the next change is the shift end.

name: permission-revoked-during-break
description: Permission REVOKED during a RELAX_ALL break: PERMISSION_ERROR; the break is still reported and its expiry is the next change.

name: permission-denied-dominates-override
description: Permission DENIED while EXEMPT_TEMPORARILY is active: PERMISSION_ERROR dominates MANAGER_OVERRIDE.

name: precedence-permission-over-override-break-and-shift-ending
description: Everything at once at 14:57 — permission DENIED, EXEMPT_TEMPORARILY 14:00–16:00 active, a break 14:50–15:10 running, inside the SHIFT_ENDING window: PERMISSION_ERROR wins, the intended restriction is the override's NONE, the break is still reported, and the shift end at 15:00 is the next change.

name: precedence-override-over-break-and-shift-ending
description: Same rows with permission APPROVED: MANAGER_OVERRIDE beats ON_BREAK and SHIFT_ENDING; the break keeps running underneath and is reported.

name: cancelled-shift-ignored
description: The only shift is CANCELLED: OFF_SHIFT, nothing upcoming.

name: completed-shift-ignored
description: Status COMPLETED is not SCHEDULED and is ignored.

name: soft-deleted-shift-ignored
description: Today's shift is soft-deleted (deletedAt set, status still SCHEDULED): ignored. Tomorrow's shift drives nextTransitionAt.

name: cancelled-shift-does-not-merge
description: 09:00–13:00 SCHEDULED followed by a CANCELLED 13:00–17:00: no merge, so 12:56 is SHIFT_ENDING.

name: soft-deleted-shift-does-not-merge
description: 09:00–13:00 SCHEDULED followed by a soft-deleted 13:00–17:00 (deletedAt set, status still SCHEDULED): no merge, so 12:56 is SHIFT_ENDING and 13:00 ends Work Mode.

name: zero-length-shift-ignored
description: A shift whose end equals its start cannot be worked and is ignored.

name: no-shifts
description: No shifts at all: OFF_SHIFT with nextTransitionAt null.

name: custom-warning-minutes-starting-soon
description: preShiftWarningMinutes 30: 08:30 opens SHIFT_STARTING_SOON.

name: custom-warning-minutes-shift-ending
description: shiftEndingWarningMinutes 10: 14:50 opens SHIFT_ENDING.

name: custom-warning-minutes-before-window
description: preShiftWarningMinutes 30: 08:29 is OFF_SHIFT, next change 08:30.

name: pre-shift-warning-zero-straight-to-working
description: preShiftWarningMinutes 0: there is no SHIFT_STARTING_SOON window, so 08:59:59.999 is OFF_SHIFT and the next change is the shift start itself.
